title: Customize Window Layout and Application Settings
trigger: User wants to adjust the appearance, editor settings, or terminal behavior

steps.action: Drag the line above the terminal band to resize it; push it down to snap the terminal closed, or drag it up to expand it
Press Ctrl+B to collapse the source control panel to a strip on the right, or press again to expand it
Drag the line between two panes to adjust their sizes relative to each other
Click the sliders glyph in the status bar to open Settings
Adjust editor settings (font size, tab width, line wrapping), terminal shell choice, and other preferences
Settings are applied when a new file or terminal is opened; existing ones retain their previous settings until closed and reopened

outcome: Window layout is resized, panes are rearranged, and application settings are updated
